Open gate directs party to garden entry
Mara stays on a quay floor or bridge
Ivo stays on a quay floor or bridge
Companions visibly walk to the gate
Mara arrives at the garden gate
Ivo joins the gate assembly
The optional clerk stays at the archive
Garden entrance is a real nearby interaction
Crossing the doorway opens the chapter without an interaction key
Mara and Ivo enter the garden with the player
Joined companions have actual 3D actors

Collection is not a return

scope: Command chapter through native scene and gameplay methods; combat victory earned. Player approaches use fixture positioning, not a navigation bot.
